queries_run: Western Digital WDC top customer revenue concentration 10-K 2026
Western Digital 10-K customers 10% net revenue hyperscaler names cloud
hyperscaler credit rating 2026 Amazon Microsoft Google balance sheet AAA capex stress

findings.claim: WDC FY2026 10-K (fiscal year ended 2026-07-03): top 10 customers accounted for 73% of net revenue (up from 68% in FY2025 and 55% in FY2024); three individual customers each contributed 16%, 15%, and 13% of net revenue respectively (versus 17%, 12%, 10% in FY2025). Cloud end market was 89% of net revenue.
findings.source: Western Digital Corp FY2026 Form 10-K, filed with SEC (wdc-20260703.htm)

findings.claim: The FY2026 10-K does not publicly name the specific customers responsible for the three 10%+ revenue concentrations; secondary reporting characterizes them as hyperscaler cloud customers, but no primary-source disclosure of individual customer identities was found.
findings.source: StockTitan summary of WDC FY2026 10-K filing

findings.claim: Among large hyperscale cloud customers broadly, credit ratings remain investment-grade and strong: Microsoft rated AAA (S&P) / Aaa (Moody's); Amazon rated AA (S&P) / AA- (Fitch) / A1 (Moody's); Alphabet rated AA+ (S&P) / Aa2 (Moody's). No customer-specific bankruptcy, downgrade, or guidance cut tied to a named WDC customer was found.
findings.source: Investing.com / CreditSights / Sage Advisory hyperscaler credit coverage

findings.claim: Moody's flagged that 'unprecedented' AI capex spending is pressuring the credit quality of Amazon, Meta, and Alphabet; hyperscaler incremental annual debt rose from 9% of capex in FY24 to 32% LTM by mid-2026 as capex increasingly shifts to external financing rather than being fully self-funded from operating cash flow.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 客戶身份未在公開 10-K 逐一具名，僅能以 hyperscaler 群體信用狀況替代查證；集中度本身逐年攀升(55%→68%→73% top10)是明確惡化事實，客戶自身信用目前仍屬投資級但槓桿/外部融資依賴度上升。

queries_run: HDD nearline storage shortage structural OR cyclical 2026 2027
Seagate Western Digital nearline HDD new capacity investment expansion timeline 2027 2028
Western Digital Seagate capital discipline avoid overbuild HDD industry 2026 CEO comments

findings.claim: WDC CEO Irving Tan stated the company is 'pretty much sold out' of HDD capacity for calendar 2026, with firm purchase orders from its top seven customers; long-term agreements (LTAs) already extend into calendar 2027 with two customers and calendar 2028 with one customer.
findings.source: TechRadar / WCCFtech, citing WDC CEO Irving Tan earnings call remarks

findings.claim: Seagate's nearline HDD capacity is fully allocated through calendar 2026, with the vast majority of nearline exabytes already allocated into calendar 2028 and customer planning discussions extending into 2029.
findings.source: TrendForce / Tom's Hardware coverage of Seagate Q4 FY2026 earnings

findings.claim: Both WDC and Seagate are pursuing a 'Disciplined Capacity' / 'Supply Discipline' strategy: refusing to build new production lines until long-term contracts are signed, rather than pre-emptively adding capacity as in prior up-cycles.
findings.source: Reporting on WDC CEO Irving Tan's 'Disciplined Capacity' strategy

findings.claim: Next-generation capacity technology (HAMR) that could relieve the shortage is not expected in volume until 2027 (Seagate 50TB-class qualification late 2027, shipments 2028) and WDC targets 40TB-class mass production in 2H2026 with HAMR volume production in 2027 and 100TB HAMR targeted for 2029 — implying supply tightness is unlikely to ease materially before 2027.
findings.source: Tom's Hardware / Trefis coverage of Seagate and WDC HDD technology roadmaps

findings.claim: Analysis characterizes the 2025-2026 HDD shortage cycle as structurally distinct from prior cyclical shortages, driven by AI-related exabyte demand rather than a temporary disaster- or inventory-driven mismatch, with incremental supply improvement possible by Q4 2026 but meaningful normalization not expected before 2027.
findings.source: Momoview storage industry analysis; multiple trade press summaries of the 2026 HDD price surge

supply_demand_durability.note: 本軸為次級媒體/產業分析彙整而非單一權威源，'structural not cyclical' 屬多篇報導共識用語而非單一可逐字追溯的一手聲明，但供應商財報 call 逐字引述(sold out through 2026、LTA 到 2027/2028)為一手可查證。
